notes: INCUMBENT: GobbleCube. The complaint quote is the brand's own words published on a vendor (GobbleCube) blog, so the vendor chose which quotes to publish; pain is in the past tense, described as solved. Chennai snacks brand; FY25 revenue Rs 46 crore (Entrackr); 'marketplaces and quick commerce accounting for roughly 55% of sales' (Inc42 14 Feb 2026). Founders named on Inc42 3 Apr 2025: Anand Bharadwaj, Nalini Parthiban, Srivatsan Sundararaman, Veera Raghavan. Series A extension: Entrackr 19 Feb 2026 says 'set to raise'; Venture Intelligence 20 Feb 2026 confirms raised, so the closed date is staged. No public ATS. Golden buyer, hunted 2026-11-20. Verifier: 5/5 SUPPORTED.
